headline: Approved funding for APWA conference and Beverly 400 water reenactment costs
summary: The board reviewed financial reports, a harbormaster update, and facilities issues including hoist pier licensing and an abandoned sailboat. It approved $1700 to fund Sean Ciancarelli's attendance at the APWA Conference and $9995 for the water portion of the Beverly 400 Hannah Nautilus battle reenactment.
decisions: Approved funding of $1700 to cover the cost for Ciancarelli to attend the APWA Conference along with incidentals, 8-0.
Approved funding of $9995 for the water portion of the Beverly 400 reenactment costs, 7-0, with Rotondo abstaining.
